title: Children’s Day Celebration Gymnastic Demonstration
summary: On the occasion of Children’s Day, SPVM organized a Gymnastic Demonstration on 14th November 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Mahila Samaj Hall, D.K.
description:
On the occasion of Children’s Day, SPVM organized a Gymnastic Demonstration on 14th November 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Mahila Samaj Hall, D.K. Sandu Marg, Chembur, Mumbai – 400071. The event showcased the gymnastic skills, talent, discipline and physical fitness of children, celebrating their enthusiasm and achievements on this special occasion.

Impact:
- Encouraged children to develop an interest in physical fitness, gymnastics and sports.
- Provided a platform for children to showcase their talent, confidence and skills.
- Promoted discipline, teamwork, coordination and self-confidence.
- Motivated children to participate in extracurricular activities and adopt a healthy, active lifestyle.
- Celebrated Children’s Day by recognising and encouraging young talent.
location: Mahila Samaj Hall, D.K. Sandu Marg, Chembur, Mumbai – 400071, Maharashtra
